title: Philly suburb: Sure, build that data center—but first meet our 43 demands
summary: The Township will not entertain such theatrics.” Lynne Viscio, president of the township council, told the Philadelphia Inquirer this week that O’Neill has “bullied” and “intimidated” township officials. The main concerns are power, water, pollution, and noise.
